prompt: Welcome screen for Loops: greet a first-time visitor with one short line about what Loops does, then offer quick-reply choices as chips. Nothing else on the screen.

sampleProps.message: Ask me what you can send with Loops, how it connects to your product, and how to get started.

quickReplies.label: What can I send with Loops?
How do I connect my product?

sampleProps.heading: Welcome to Loops

profile.direction: Card ground = the page surface (never the ink role as a container surface); the host's ink for type, rows and arrows; the greeting as a compact brand band at most one third of the card (eyebrow in the primary colour, heading, one-line message), then the quick replies as tight full-width rows separated by hairlines, each with a trailing arrow in the primary colour; no icons elsewhere, no helper text, no status line; fit a 400×560 card without scrolling.
